tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground – pure white in light. Sidebar, toolbars and page content sit directly on it; cards separate by `border` + `shadow-sm`.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `background`, `card`, `popover`, `muted` and `accent` (≥ 15:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas below the content plane: board columns. White cards sit on it, so they read clearly without darkening the page.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card, panel, table and list fill — one step lighter than `background` in both themes, plus a `border` hairline and `shadow-sm`.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Fill of menus, popovers, tooltips and dialogs; pair with `shadow-md` and a `border` hairline.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one main action per view (primary button fill), active switch track, selected tab indicator.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` (≥ 16:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, neutral badge fill.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: drop-target column, skeletons, code blocks, switch track when off. Distinct from both `background` and `card`.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, meta, captions, column headers, placeholder. Legible on `background`, `card`, `field` and `muted` (≥ 4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and highlighted fill of ghost buttons, menu items, table rows and list rows.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete / irreversible actions and error text on `background` and `card` (≥ 4.5:1). Always paired with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a `destructive` fill (4.8:1 light, 7:1 dark).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success status dot and text on `background` and `card` (≥ 4.5:1). Always beside a word ("Aktiv"), never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning status dot and text on `background` and `card` (≥ 4.5:1). Always beside a word.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card, table and list outlines, row dividers, separators. Visible on `background` and `card` in both themes. Not for control outlines (use `input`).

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, selects, outline buttons, checkboxes and switches (≥ 3:1 on `background`, `card` and `field` in both themes).

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Fill of inputs, selects, textareas, checkboxes and outline buttons — always lighter (light) or a step off (dark) the `background`, so controls read as places to type.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px over `background` (≥ 9:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: switch-thumb
tokens.usage: Knob of a switch that is off, on the `input` grey track (≥ 3:1 in both themes). When on, the knob takes `primary-foreground` on `primary`.

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb, shown only while the scroll area is hovered; no track, no arrows. Darkens to `muted-foreground` when the thumb itself is hovered.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and sheets; never behind menus or popovers.

tokens.name: label-gray
tokens.usage: User-chosen label colour for board columns (dot + 7 % tint of the column). Decoration chosen by the user only – never carries status meaning; the column name always stays.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons, tabs, column headers.

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Meta, timestamps, helper text — set in `muted-foreground`.

styles.name: text-code
styles.usage: IDs, addresses, keys, numbers that must align (tabular).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside small controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls (button group, label → input).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons and inputs; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between form fields groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top padding, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, menu items, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs list.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, dialogs, tables' outer frame.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels and sheets only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switch, status dots, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting lift of cards, tables, lists and form controls — with a `border` hairline, never alone.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Floating layers (menus, popovers, tooltips, dialogs) and the hover state of interactive cards.
